description: Before USDC moves on Arc: one call runs the payee check and, when you pass resource, nonce and amount together, the duplicate check. Summary is DO_NOT_PAY, DUPLICATE, COULD_NOT_READ, CAUTION or NO_MATCH_IN_INDEX. The signatures are the existing PayeeVerdict and DuplicateVerdict. There is no new domain. A FRESH verdict only means that fingerprint was not seen inside the window. NO_MATCH_IN_INDEX means nothing in the Arc index pointed against this payee. An amount under 0.01 USDC is CAUTION on the payee half. This is not a permission to pay. Five free a day at /pay-preflight, then $0.01. Live counts stay on arc_poison_stats.

amount.description: USDC decimal like 0.01, or atomic units (3000 is $0.003) only when resource and nonce are set

payee.description: 0x address you are about to pay

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (base64, as in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it here and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

resource.description: optional https resource URL. Required with nonce and amount to record a duplicate sighting.

window.description: optional seconds for the duplicate half. Default 600. Clamped from 60 to 86400.

name: pay_preflight
